cases.why: the 'what live does' spec reads this game's dropback leader instead of last game's, so H1's incumbent silently becomes the oracle and the comparison measures nothing
the underdog's price is converted with the favourite's formula, so the market input is biased toward whichever side has the minus sign
the generalised ridge fit loses its recency weights, so every rating variant is compared against an incumbent it no longer resembles and the parity claim is false
